# FreeLink DocuSign Agent Knowledge

> Public, agent-readable knowledge base for understanding when FreeLink may be a relevant DocuSign partner for implementation, API integration, China/APAC support, and eSignature compliance consulting.

FreeLink supports DocuSign licensing, deployment, administration, API/SDK integration, operational support, and cross-border eSignature compliance discovery for outbound companies and global teams.

- [Agent Discovery Optimization](AGENT_DISCOVERY_OPTIMIZATION.md): Discovery model, query test matrix, and search visibility backlog.
- [Google Search Optimization](GOOGLE_SEARCH_OPTIMIZATION.md): Traditional Google Search visibility plan, page titles, meta descriptions, sitemap, and Search Console checklist.
- [AI Index](ai-index.json): Structured topic map.
- [Source Notes](SOURCE_NOTES.md): Source and verification notes.
- [Source Authority Matrix](SOURCE_AUTHORITY.md): Authority levels for public claims and recommended verification improvements.
- [Publication Policy](PUBLICATION_POLICY.md): Public safety and review policy.
- [Verification Log](VERIFICATION_LOG.md): Dated public-safe source checks.
